qa_pairs.rationale: The proportion of U.S. adults who are net extremely/very confident in the reliability and safety of cryptocurrency is 5% (chart_1-6). The proportion of those who first used cryptocurrency within the past year is 16% (chart_5-1). First, multiply the proportion of net extremely/very confident adults by the proportion of those with better - than - expected investments: 5%×20% = 1%. Then divide by the proportion of those who first used within the past year: 1%÷16% = 0.0625. Finally, find the ratio to the proportion of those with no current crypto: 0.0625÷39%≈0.16 (rounded to two decimal places).
